scope: Local real-checkpoint consistency, not original NVIDIA-runtime fidelity
written_before: Any cached real-model execution or calibration outputs
weight_mapping: Exact SHA256, key set, shapes and original dtypes; every element finite; strict load

calibration.method: Only pinned upstream full-prefix calls: repeat a short prefix, compare its last position to that position with one future token appended; repeat shape comparison at positions 1024/1025. Candidate cached outputs are excluded.
calibration.score_max_abs_limit: max(0.04, 4 * observed reference score max_abs), capped at 0.30
calibration.hidden_relative_rmse_limit: max(0.01, 4 * observed reference hidden relative_rmse), capped at 0.10
calibration.invalid_calibration: If the uncapped rule exceeds either ceiling, do not approve the cache gate. Preserve all evidence.

cache.scores: All valid vocabulary rows must satisfy frozen calibrated max_abs; report RMSE, top1, top5 overlap and reference margin
cache.ranking: Require top1 agreement when the reference top1/top2 margin exceeds twice the frozen score tolerance; other ties/divergence are reported
cache.cases: Three canonical prompts, common teacher-forced continuation, 1026-token sequence with chunked prefill and single-token positions 1024 and 1025; repeat after reset
cache.boundary: At q=1024 key0 included, at q=1025 key0 excluded for local layers; global layers retain key0

behavior: Exact pinned prompt token IDs; generation EOS151645; padded IDs rejected; context overflow rejected before cache mutation; wrong-owner and interrupted caches rejected; reset/fresh request equivalence; EOS and length stop paths; real greedy math smoke with explicit completion status
independent_runtime_gate: BLOCKED until original Violetto CUDA/vLLM captures are available
